comparison.objective: Pour mixed coins from a jar and sort them by denomination; candidate transfers an uncaged bearing block.
comparison.physical_skill: Record tests container pouring, perception-based sorting, and planar pushing of thin free bodies. Candidate tests bimanual alignment and constrained sliding of an assembled mechanism.
comparison.success_condition: Record awards coins wholly inside their denomination frames; wrong, unsorted, or jar-retained coins fail individually. Candidate requires every original ball to remain inside four circulation rows during complete transfer.
comparison.reason: Handling many loose coins is not mechanically equivalent to preserving internal rolling-element support in a bearing assembly.
